title: HOPE — Data-tier Dependencies
description: Runtime dependencies of the HOPE platform. TASK-847: every panel here now reads an IN-CLUSTER target. It previously described Proxmox VMs — Patroni/PgBouncer on 10.10.1.200-202, Redis on .120-121, MinIO on .102, Vault on .130-132 — which the platform no longer talks to; that is the 'Grafana still shows an out-of-cluster database dashboard' symptom, and its cause was the Prometheus scrape config, not this file. Panels with no in-cluster equivalent (Patroni cluster role, replication/cluster lock, both PgBouncer pool panels, Redis evictions) were deleted rather than left permanently empty.

title: HOPE — Model Residency
description: Per-GPU VRAM headroom, per-model resident bytes, load latency and eviction/admission behaviour for the TASK-1005 ModelResidencyController (stt, nlp, LM Studio). Backing metrics land with the controller and agent-API lanes; panels read "No data" until those merge.

title: HOPE — Platform (Application Plane)
description: The application plane: what HOPE itself is doing, as opposed to what the cluster underneath it is doing. Answers 'is the product working' — gateway throughput and latency, realtime transcription health, AI service behaviour, and background job outcomes. For node, storage, GPU and data-tier questions use the Infrastructure Overview, Node & System Activity, GPU and Data-tier Dependencies boards instead. Every connection/session number here is an application-level count; host socket counters live on the Node board and are not comparable.

title: HOPE — SDK Clients
description: Client-side health of @arcaai/vox (browser) and @arcaai/vox-node (server), from SDK spans (Tempo span-metrics) and SDK logs (Loki). Only the allow-listed hope.sdk.* attributes exist here - no patient data.

title: HOPE — vLLM Inference
description: The vLLM general-inference service (TASK-1021 Phase 1: Whisper ASR pool): traffic and latency by kind, ASR real-time factor, admission and saturation, engine loads and evictions, resident VRAM against the pool budget, and the upstream KV-cache and scheduler series. No tenant label anywhere: this plane stays PHI-free. Panels read "No data" until a pool is scaled up and scraped.
